name: SmokeTrails (missile smoke ropes + thin exhaust contrail)
triangles: 2 per live puff; 6000 at capacity 3000 (board peak 370 puffs = 740)
textures: shared 512x512 RGBA puff atlas (particles.ts), baked once ~134 ms
notes: Distance-based emission (spacing 0.62 m in A) with 30 puffs/s floor; ~110 puffs/s per missile at 66-110 m/s, so 3000 puffs covers ~8-10 concurrent 2 s missile trails (ring overwrites the oldest). Sorted back-to-front each frame (radix, no allocation). Group can live in world or rail frame; `wind` drifts puffs.
